verdict.rationale: DPMA runs its own public register, DPMAregister, covering patents, utility models, trade marks and designs. That is the natural place to look up a filing, but the evidence only names the register and never describes showing application or case status. The robots.txt probe only limits crawling; it does not contradict public lookup. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that DPMAregister shows procedural status of pending applications or cases, details of how to search by file number, and hands-on corroboration of a status lookup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
